description: An APC UPS over SNMP: protection status, power drawn against capacity, input quality and battery health. Collapsed rows hold daily energy, readings, power events, the battery record, charge and voltage.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: What the UPS is doing now. BOOSTING and TRIMMING correct a bad input; ON BATTERY means it failed.

targets.expr:
max by (instance) (
  (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="onLine"} == 1) * 0
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="ecoMode"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="eConversion"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="powerSavingMode"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="hotStandby"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="activeLoad"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="selfTest"} == 1) * 2
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="onBatteryTest"} == 1) * 2
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="onSmartBoost"} == 1) * 3
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="onSmartTrim"} == 1) * 4
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="softwareBypass"} == 1) * 5
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="switchedBypass"} == 1) * 5
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="hardwareFailureBypass"} == 1) * 5
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="emergencyStaticBypass"} == 1) * 5
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="staticBypassStandby"} == 1) * 5
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="onBattery"} == 1) * 7
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="batteryDischargeSpotmode"} == 1) * 7
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="off"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="timedSleeping"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="sleepingUntilPowerReturn"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="rebooting"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="inverterStandby"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicOutputStatus="chargerOnly"} == 1) * 8
  or (upsBasicOutputStatus{instance=~"$ups"} == 1) * 6
  or (upsCommStatus_ok{instance=~"$ups"} == 0) + 9
)

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Battery condition. REPLACE comes from the UPS's battery-life algorithm or a failed self-test.

targets.expr:
max by (instance) (
  (upsBasicBatteryStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicBatteryStatus="batteryNormal"} == 1) * 0
  or (upsBasicBatteryStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicBatteryStatus="unknown"} == 1) * 1
  or (upsAdvBattery_needsreplacing{instance=~"$ups"} > 0) * 0 + 2
  or (upsBasicBatteryStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicBatteryStatus="batteryLow"} == 1) * 3
  or (upsBasicBatteryStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicBatteryStatus="batteryInFaultCondition"} == 1) * 4
  or (upsBasicBatteryStatus{instance=~"$ups",upsBasicBatteryStatus="noBatteryPresent"} == 1) * 5
)

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Share of rated capacity the equipment draws now.

panels.title: Runtime
panels.description: How long the battery would carry the current load.

panels.title: Input
panels.description: Utility voltage at the input now.

panels.title: Energy
panels.description: Energy delivered to the equipment in the selected range.

panels.title: Power and capacity
panels.description: Real power the equipment draws against what the UPS can deliver (dashed, derived from load %). The gap is headroom.

panels.title: Input voltage
panels.description: Utility voltage as each minute's lowest-to-highest band. A wide or low band is a sag or spike.

panels.title: Battery temperature
panels.description: Temperature at the battery. Lead-acid lasts longest at 20-25 °C; every 8 °C above roughly halves its life.

panels.title: Battery runtime
panels.description: Battery runtime at each moment's load; it falls as load rises.

panels.title: Energy per day
panels.description: Energy the equipment used each day over the last two weeks, whatever range is selected.

panels.title: Power readings
panels.description: Power factor is real over apparent power; heat lost is what the UPS spends to deliver it.

panels.title: Power events
panels.description: What the UPS did over time: passing power through, correcting the input, testing itself or running on battery.

panels.description: What the UPS stores about its battery. Last transfer is why it last ran on battery.

panels.title: Battery charge
panels.description: Battery charge. It dips after a self-test or time on battery, then recharges.

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Voltage at the battery terminals. A float voltage that sags over months is a cell on its way out.
